tools.name: search_lots
tools.description: Finds Park Graph parking lots near a latitude and longitude, nearest first, with spaces left and the current rate. No API key needed. tools.name: get_lot
tools.description: Full public details for one lot: address, coordinates, spaces, features, hours, pricing and spaces left right now. No API key needed. Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Price to park at a lot for a number of hours, at the lot's current rate (daily max applied). No API key needed. booking.mode in the result is the next step: reserve (the reserve tool holds a space) or pay_at_qr_page (booking.pay_url is the lot's pay page, where the driver pays and parks). tools.name: reserve
